nodes.label: Manufacturing Core Workflow - Production Planning to Stock Movement
nodes.rationale: Sales Order → Production Plan (demand sourcing) → Work Orders + Material Requirements → Material Transfer + Manufacture Stock Entry → Bin updates. Submission lifecycle controls reservation/GL impact.

nodes.label: Production Plan - Sales Order Demand Sourcing
nodes.rationale: Eligible SO Items have docstatus=1, active BOM, pending qty (stock_qty - stock_reserved_qty > work_order_qty). BOM-based filtering. combine_items merges by bom_no.

nodes.label: Production Plan - Sub-Assembly BOM Explosion
nodes.rationale: Entirely server-side via get_sub_assembly_items. Branches on type_of_manufacturing (In House → Work Order, Subcontract → PO, Material Request → MR). skip_available_sub_assembly_item checks projected qty.

nodes.label: Production Plan - Material Requirement Planning Calculation
nodes.rationale: shortage = max(0, required_qty - (available_qty - safety_stock)). available_qty from Bin.projected_qty only when ignore_existing_ordered_qty checked. requested_qty tracks what's already MR'd, prevents double-request.
